::: {#exr-soft-rule-module}

#### The soft rule as a PyTorch model

Write the [soft 0-or-1 rule](ml-review.qmd#exr-log-loss-curve) as a subclass of PyTorch's `nn.Module` whose cutoff is an `nn.Parameter`,
and train it with `torch.optim.SGD`,
from the start, learning rate and number of steps of @exr-autograd-descent.

:::
